bead.title: harness: discovery is the only source of truth — live PTY at runtime; cassettes are test-only
bead.description:
Principle: at runtime, harness-exposed models come from the live TUI only. If the harness can't tell us what it exposes (codex /model, claude /model, gemini --list-models, opencode/pi equivalents), the harness is broken — surface the error, do not substitute.

Cassettes (testdata/model_surface/) are test fixtures only — used by unit tests to exercise the parser/reader without a live binary. They are NOT a runtime data source and NOT a fallback when live discovery fails.

What to remove from runtime paths:
- defaultCodexModelDiscovery() at internal/harnesses/codex/model_discovery.go:20
- defaultClaudeModelDiscovery() at internal/harnesses/claude/model_discovery.go:27
- defaultGeminiModelDiscovery() at internal/harnesses/gemini/model_discovery.go:20
- HarnessConfig.Models hardcoded literals at internal/harnesses/registry.go:21,52,72,101,131
- Any DefaultModelSnapshot() implementation that reads from a cassette in production code paths

Runtime replacement contract: DefaultModelSnapshot() (or the v0.11 equivalent) MUST drive the live TUI via the existing ReadXModelDiscoveryViaPTY helpers. The result is cached per ADR-012 (per-source on-disk cache, TTL-bounded). On PTY failure or timeout: return error; service consumers surface model-unknown / harness-broken.

Cassettes still exist — they serve ReadXModelDiscoveryFromCassette which is exercised only from unit tests and from harness_integration drift detection in CI.
bead.acceptance:
1) grep -rn 'defaultCodexModelDiscovery\|defaultClaudeModelDiscovery\|defaultGeminiModelDiscovery' internal/harnesses/ --include=*.go returns zero hits in production (non _test.go) files.
2) HarnessConfig.Models field is removed from internal/harnesses/registry.go and all five hardcoded literals at lines 21,52,72,101,131 are gone.
3) Each harness's runtime ModelDiscoveryHarness.DefaultModelSnapshot() calls a live PTY discovery helper (ReadXModelDiscoveryViaPTY) with a sensible timeout; never reads a cassette in production code paths; never returns a fabricated list.
4) Live discovery results are cached per ADR-012 with a documented TTL.
5) On live PTY failure or absent binary: harness returns a sentinel error; service surfaces it (model list empty + error event) rather than silently substituting.
6) Cassettes survive under testdata/model_surface/ but are referenced only by *_test.go and harness_integration-tagged drift tests.
7) go test ./... -count=1 green.
